info.name: Interview Platform — Phase 4 (Full: security, waiting, video tokens, run, notes, room, cross-org)
info.description:
End-to-end Phase 4 collection that drives ONE interview through the whole story in the mandated order, with the security case FIRST:

1) Auth — password-grant tokens for recruiter A (org A) and recruiter B (org B), org claim asserted.
2) Schedule — a unique-per-run interview (runId-suffixed candidate email/phone, `preparedQuestions` sent as JSON ARRAYS), plus regenerate-link to expose the raw join token.
3) SECURITY FIRST — a video token for a NOT-yet-admitted candidate is refused (403) through the public endpoint.
4) Candidate waiting — public POST /api/public/join-tokens/{token}/waiting (200), recruiter GET /room/waiting-status shows waiting=true, and an invalid token on the same endpoint is refused (401).
5) Admit — the same public video-token call now mints (200) and waiting-status shows admitted=true.
6) Run — start the interview (IN_PROGRESS), start then end a segment, asserting actualStart/actualEnd.
7) Notes — create one note tied to the segment and one interview-level note (201, elapsedSeconds present), list them ascending by createdAt.
8) Room bootstrap — GET /room returns interview + segments + currentSegment + notes.
9) Cross-org — recruiter B hits EVERY recruiter endpoint on org A's interview and gets 404 each (start, complete, admit, no-show, reschedule, regenerate-link, revoke-link, segment start/end, notes POST/GET, /room, /waiting-status, video-token).

Set recruiterAPassword / recruiterBPassword in Collection -> Variables (passwords equal usernames: recruiter1 / recruiter2). Run order is top-to-bottom; every folder depends on the previous one. All traffic goes through http://localhost:8080 (gateway).

Known notes:
- The api-gateway SecurityConfig does not yet have a permitAll for POST /api/public/join-tokens/{token}/waiting (only the service-side permits it). To keep this collection green through the gateway today, the two public waiting POSTs carry recruiter A's bearer (an authenticated exchange is forwarded; the service still treats the endpoint as public and only validates the join token). If/when the gateway permitAll is added these requests keep working unchanged.
- The public waiting POST returns 200 with an empty body; the waiting=true/false signal lives on the recruiter waiting-status endpoint.
- The waiting-status field is `waiting` (boolean) alongside `admitted` and `candidateWaitingSince`.

item.name: 4 — Candidate waiting signal
item.description:
The candidate signals arrival via the public waiting endpoint, and the recruiter sees waiting=true on /waiting-status. Then an invalid token on the same public endpoint is refused.

Gateway note: the api-gateway does not yet permit POST /api/public/join-tokens/*/waiting (service-side does), so these two waiting POSTs attach recruiter A's bearer to get through :8080; the service still processes them as public token lookups and never uses the tenant claim.

request.description: The candidate's browser signals 'I am in the waiting room'. The service records candidateWaitingSince on the interview and returns 200. (Bearer attached purely to traverse the gateway until its permitAll for this path is added — see folder description.)

request.description: Recruiter A sees the candidate is waiting: waiting=true, candidateWaitingSince set, admitted still false.

request.description: A join token that was never issued hashes to a nonexistent row, so the same public waiting endpoint refuses with 401 (the same status the candidate video-token path uses for terminal token states). (Bearer attached purely to traverse the gateway — see folder description.)
